description: Executable Candidate recipe of NVIDIA's own DGX Spark playbook (trt-llm) for Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 30B-A3B NVFP4: the NGC TensorRT-LLM release image 1.3.0rc13 (pinned by arm64 digest) serving the exact model revision through trtllm-serve with the playbook's LLM API options. Resource envelopes are estimates from the playbook's 0.8-0.9 KV memory fraction, not measurements; physical Spark acceptance is pending.
title: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 30B-A3B NVFP4 TensorRT-LLM single Spark (NVIDIA playbook)
